ground.name: Ground · backs and quarterbacks
ground.note: The standard ticket: one back or quarterback per team, run-defence matchup in the order.

air.name: Air · receivers and tight ends
air.note: Pass-catchers only, one per team, ranked on the play-at probability.

mixed.name: Mixed · half backs, half pass-catchers
mixed.note: No position more than half the legs.

matchup.name: Matchup-weighted · any position
matchup.note: Ranked on the model plus the matchup index: line play and run defence for backs; dropbacks, pass protection, yards per target allowed and end-zone share for pass-catchers.

fav.name: Favourites · teams implied 25.5+
fav.note: Only offences the market expects to score most.

combo.name: Combo · ground and air
combo.note: The most likely mix at each size: 3 ground + 1 air, 4 + 2, 5 + 3. One player per team.
